n, b = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
cuts = []
even = 0
odd = 0
for i in range(n):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        even += 1
    else:
        odd += 1
    if even == odd and i != n - 1:
        cuts.append(i + 1)
        even = 0
        odd = 0
count = 0
m = len(cuts)
if m > 1:
    heap = sorted([abs(a[p] - a[p - 1]) for p in cuts])
    spent = 0
    for cost in heap:
        if spent + cost <= b:
            spent += cost
            count += 1
        else:
            break
elif m == 1:
    p = cuts[0]
    if abs(a[p] - a[p - 1]) <= b:
        count = 1
print(count)
</translated_code>
